original_values.promise: NVIDIA announced that Blackwell-based products would be available from partners later in 2024.
original_values.description: NVIDIA announced the Blackwell platform on March 18, 2024. It later reported $11 billion in Blackwell revenue for fiscal Q4 2025, a quarter ending in January 2025.
evidence: The launch release gives the calendar-2024 partner-availability target.
The fiscal-quarter revenue report does not isolate calendar-year availability.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21 for the original deadline: the checked financial report spans the year boundary.

review.note: Due 2024-12-31; no outcome evidence was established in the 2026-10-25 review, so the status remains pending under the preservation policy.

records.rationale: A December 9, 2024 Dell release carried by CoreWeave confirms GB200 NVL72 rack shipments within the promised calendar year. This is partner hardware availability, not a claim of universal cloud general availability.

original_values.promise: Lucasfilm announced Patty Jenkins's Rogue Squadron for Christmas 2023.
original_values.description: Lucasfilm announced Rogue Squadron during its December 10, 2020 presentation, with Patty Jenkins directing and a Christmas 2023 theatrical target.
evidence: Lucasfilm's announcement supports the project and Christmas 2023 target.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked announcement does not establish cancellation or actual release.

review.note: The December 10 announcement supports Christmas 2023, not an exact December 22 deadline. The asserted shelving and absence of all Star Wars films through 2025 require outcome evidence; publication remains withheld.

records.rationale: Reuters reports removal from the December 2023 schedule in September 2022; Jenkins still owed a script draft in March 2024, as reported by TheWrap. The missed original schedule supports broken without asserting permanent cancellation. Exact December 22 precision and original citation gaps remain flagged.
